senses.gloss: त॑द्-अ॑हर् त॑द् अ॑हर् acc. ind. on that very day, ŚBr.
त॑द् (तद्) n. this world (cf. इदम्), R. vi, 102, 25
= Brahma See तत्-त्व
त॑द् (त॑द्) ind. there, in that place, thither, to that spot (correlative of य॑त्र or य॑तस्), AV.; AitBr. ii, 11; ŚBr. i, x, xiv; ChUp.
त॑द् ind. then, at that time, in that case (correlative of यदा॑, य॑द्, AV.; of य॑त्र, ŚBr. xiv; of यदि, Nal.; Bhag. &c.; of चेद्, Śak. &c.), RV. iv, 28, 1; AV. &c.
thus, in this manner, with regard to that, ix, xiii; ŚBr.; AitBr.
(तद् एतौ श्लोकौ भवतः, ‘with reference to that there are these two verses’), PraśnUp.
on that account, for that reason, therefore, consequently (sometimes correlative of यतस्, यद्, येन, ‘because’, Daś.; Pañcat.; Kathās. &c.), Mn. ix, 41; MBh. &c.
now (clause-connecting particle), AV. xv; ŚBr.; AitBr.
so also, equally, and AV. xi, xv
तद् तद् तद् this and that, various, different (e.g. तं तं देशं जगाम, ‘he went to this and that place’; तासु तासु योनिषु, ‘in different or various birth-places’, Mn. xii, 74)
तद् तद् तद् respective, BṛNārP. xiii, 88
तद् तेनैव तेनैव पथा, on quite the same path, R. iii, 50, 28

तद् यद् तद् whosoever, whichsoever, any, every (also with वा, Mn. xii, 68 [यद् वा तद् वा, ‘this or that, any’] Hariv. 5940; Dhūrtas.; Śak., Sch.; often both pronouns repeated or the interrogative pron. with चिद् added after the relative, e.g. यद्-यत् पर-वशं कर्म तत्-तद् वर्जयेत्, ‘whatever action depends on another, that he should avoid’, Mn. iv, 159; यत् किं-चिद्-तद्, ‘whatever-that’, Mn.)
तद् तन् न. See s.v. चेद्
तद् तद् ind. अपि ‘even then’, nevertheless, notwithstanding, Śak. (v.l.), Bhartṛ.; Prab.; Siṃhās.
तद् (ind.) यथा, ‘in such a manner as follows’, namely, viz. Buddh. (cf. Pāli seyyathā; स॑ य॑था-, ŚBr.); Jain. (in Prākṛt taṃ jahā; cf. sejjahā), Pat.; Śak.
तद् [cf. ὁ, ἡ, τό; Goth. sa, sō, that-a; Lat. (is-)te, (is-)ta, (is-)tud, tam, tum, tunc.]
तद्—अतिपात mfn. transgressing that, W.
तद्—अनन्तर mf(आ)n. nearest to any one (gen.), Nal. xxii, 16
तद्—अनन्तरम् ind. immediately upon that, thereupon, then (corresponding to प्राक्, ‘before’, Śak. vii, 30; to प्रथमम्, ‘first’, Mn. viii, 129), MBh. &c.
तद्—अनु ind. after that, afterwards, Megh.; Ratnāv.; Amar.; Śrut.; Subh.
तद्—अनुकृति ind. conformably to that, accordingly, AitBr. vi, 1, 2.
तद्—अनुसरण n. going after that, Sāh. i, 2/3, 58
तद्—अनुसरण—क्रमेण ind. instr. See s.v. क्र॑म.
त॑द्—अन्त (त॑द्-), mfn. coming to an end by that, TBr. i, 5, 9, 3; Hit.
त॑द्—अन्न (त॑द्-), mfn. accustomed to that food, RV. viii, 47, 16
eating (that i.e.) the same food, R. ii, 103, 30 and 140, 13.
तद्—अन्य mfn. other than that, L.
तद्—अन्वय mfn. descended from him, VP. iv, 2, 2.
तद्—अपत्य mfn. having offspring from him, Mn. iii, 16 (-ता f. abstr.)
तद्—अपत्य—ता f., abstr.
तद्—अपत्य—मय mfn. thinking of one's off spring only, Subh.
त॑द्—अपस् (त॑द्-), mfn. accustomed to that work or to do that, RV. ii, 13, 3 and 38, 1; viii, 47, 16
त॑द्—अपस् ind. in the usual way, v, 47, 2.
तद्—अपेक्ष mfn. having regard to that, Gaut.
तद्—अर्थ mfn. intended for that, Āp. ii, 14, 3; Pāṇ. ii, 1, 36; i, 3, 72, Kāś.
serving for that, Jaim. i, 2, 1 (अ- neg.)
having that or the same meaning, Pāṇ. ii, 3, 58
तद्—अर्थ m. (its or) their meaning, Vedāntas. 200
तद्—अर्थम् ind. on that account, with that object, for that end, therefore, Pāṇ. v, 1, 12; R. i, 73, 4; VarBṛS. lxxiv, Kāś.; VP. iv
तद्—अर्थ—ता f. = तादर्थ्य, ĀśvŚr. iii, 4, 12, Sch.
तद्—अर्थक mf(इका)n. denoting that, Naiṣ. iv, 52.
तद्—˚अर्थीय mfn. intended for that, undertaken for that end, Bhag. xvii, 27.
तद्—˚अर्धिक mfn. half as much, Mn. iii, 1.
तद्—अर्पण n. delivery of that, W.
तद्—अर्ह see अ-.
तद्—अवधि ind. from that time, Bhām. ii, 56
up to that period, W.
तद्—अवस्थ mfn. so situated, thus circumstanced, in that condition, MBh. iii, 69, 31; Ratnāv.
being in the same condition (as before), undamaged, iv, 19.
तद्—अहे loc. ind. on that day, Hemac.
तद्—आकार mfn. having that appearance, W.
तद्—आकार—परिज्ञान n. N. of an art, Gal.
तद्—आत्मक mfn. constituting its nature, Car. vi, 12; Sarvad. xv.
तादात्मक mf(इका)n. (fr. तद्-आत्मन्) denoting the unity of nature, RāmatUp. i, 19.
तद्—आदि ind. from that time forward, Śiś. i, 45; Dharmaśarm.
तद्—आमुख n. beginning of that, L.
तद्—इ॑द्-अर्थ mfn. intent on that particular object, RV. viii, 2, 16 (cf. ii, 39, 1; ix, 1, 5; x, 106, 1).
तद्—इद्-आसीय n. the hymn, RV. x, 120; ŚāṅkhŚr. xi.
त॑द्—इष्टि (त॑द्-), mfn. accompanied by such offerings, AV. xi, 7, 19.
तद्—एक-चित्त mfn. having all the thoughts fixed on that (person or thing), Hit.
तद्—एवोपनिषद् f. N. of an Up. (beginning with the words तद् एव).
त॑द्—ओकस् (त॑द्-), mfn. rejoicing in that, RV. i, 15, 1; iii, 35, 7; iv, 49, 6; vii, 29, 1.
त॑द्—ओजस् (त॑द्-), mfn. endowed with such strength, v, 1, 8.
तद्—गत mfn. directed towards him or her or them or that, R. i f.; Kathās. iii, 68
ifc. intent on Vet. iv, 22
तद्—गत m. (?) the continued multiplication of 4 or more like quantities, W.
तद्—गुण mfn. possessing these qualities, KātyŚr. xiv f.
तद्—गुण m. the quality of that or those, xii f.
xvi
xxiii f.
the virtue of (that or) those (persons), Ragh. i, 9
(in rhet.) transferring the qualities of one thing to another (a figure of speech), Sāh. x, 90; Kuval.; Kpr. x, 51
also अ- neg. ‘a figure of speech in which a quality expected in any object is denied’, 52
तद्—गुण—त्व n. the having its qualities, Jaim. vi, 7, 16 (अ- neg.)

तद्—गुण—संविज्ञान n. (a Bahuvrīhi compound) in which the qualities implied are perceived along with the thing itself (e.g. दीर्घकर्ण, ‘long-ear’; opposed to अ-, e.g. दृष्टसागर, ‘one who has seen the ocean’), Bādar. i, 1, 2, Sch.; Sarvad.
तद्—दिन n. that, day, W.
तद्—दिनम् ind. on a certain day, W.
during the day, W.
every day, W.
तद्—दुःख n. grief for that or of that, W.
तद्—देवत mfn. having that deity, KātyŚr. xxiv, 6; ĀpŚr. vii; PārGṛ. iii, 11, 10.
तद्—देवताक mfn. id., RV. x, 18; Sāy.
तद्—देवत्य mfn. id., Lāṭy. iv, 4, 21.
तद्—देश्य mfn. coming from the same country, (m.) a fellow-countryman, MBh. xii, 168, 41; Kām. xiii, 77.
तद्—दैवत mfn. = -देव्˚, Nir. vii, 1; PārGṛ. iii, 11, 10.
तद्—दैवत्य mf(आ)n. id., VarBṛS. ic, 3.
तद्—द्वितीय mfn. doing that for the 2nd time, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 162, Kāś.
तद्—धन mfn. niggardly, L.
तद्-धर्म mfn. having the same qualities, ĀpY.
तद्—धर्मन् mfn. practising that, iii, 2, 134
accomplishing his business, KātyŚr. i, 6, 12; Jaim. vi, 3, 26 (cf. ताद्धर्म्य)
तद्—धर्˚म-त्व n. the having his or its peculiarity, KapS. i, 52 (अ- neg.)
तद्—धर्मिन् mfn. obeying his laws, BhP. iii, 15, 32.
तद्—˚धर्म्य mfn. of that kind, v, 14, 2.
ताद्धर्म्य n. (fr. तद्-धर्मन्) sameness of law, analogy, L.
तद्—धारण n. N. of an art, Gal.
तद्—धित n. (हित) sg. and pl. his welfare, Āp. ii; BhP. ii, 9, 7

तद्—धित m. (scil. प्रत्यय) an affix forming nouns from other nouns (opposed to 1. कृत्), noun formed thus, derivative noun (तद्-धित mfn. ‘good for that or him’, is one of the meanings peculiar to derivative nouns, cf. मौदकिक &c.), Nir. ii, 2; Prāt.; Pāṇ.; ŚāṅkhGṛ.; PārGṛ.; Gobh. ii, 8, 15 (also अ—तद्-धित neg. mfn. ‘having no Taddhita affix’)
ताद्धित mfn. formed with a Tad-dhita affix, Nir. ii, 5.
तद्—धित—ढुण्ढी f. N. of a gloss on the Taddhita chapter in Hemachandra's grammar by Ānandagaṇi.
त॑द्—बन्धु (त॑द्-), mfn. belonging to that family or race, RV. x, 61, 18.
तद्—बल, m. or तद्—ब˚ला, f. a kind of arrow, L.
तद्—बल, m. or तद्—ब˚ला, f. a kind of arrow, L.
तद्—बहु mfn. doing that often, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 162, Kāś.
तद्—बहुल-विहारिन् mfn. id., Divyāv. xvii, 182; 463; 482.
तद्—भव mfn. = तज्ज, Mn. iv, 232, Medhāt.
तद्—भाव m. the becoming that, KātyŚr. iv, 3, 13; Bādar. iii, 4, 40 (अ- neg., ‘the becoming [not that i.e.] something else’)
his intentions, Kām. xi, 29; xviii, 3
तद्—भाव mfn. ifc. ‘becoming’, see अ-भूत-.
तद्—भिन्न mfn. different from that.
तद्—भूत mfn. being in that, Jaim. i, 1, 25.
तद्—रस m. the spirit thereof, W.
तद्—राज m. (scil. प्रत्यय) an affix added to the N. of a race for forming the N. of its chief, Pāṇ. ii, 4, 62; iv, 1, 174; v, 3, 119.
तद्—रूप mf(आ)n. thus shaped, so formed, looking thus, KapS. v, 19 and Jaim. vi, 5, 3 (-त्व n. abstr.), Pañcat.; Pāṇ. vii, 3, 86, Sch.
of the same quality, Sarvad. xv, 354; Vām. iv, 3, 9 (अ- neg. ‘of different quality’)
अ-, ‘reverse’, Bādar. iii, 4, 40.
तद्—रूप—त्व n., abstr.
तद्—वचः-प्रतीत mfn. believing his words.
तद्—वत् mfn. having or containing that, VPrāt.; Pāṇ. iv, 4, 125; KapS. i, v; Tarkas. &c.
तद्—वत् ind. like that, thus, so (correlative of यद्-वत्, Mn. x, 13; Bhag.; Pañcat.; of यथा, ‘as’, ŚvetUp. ii, 14 [v.l. for तद्-वा] MBh. i, vii &c.), ŚāṅkhGṛ. v, 9, 3 &c.
in like manner, likewise, also, Śrut.; Kathās. vi, xxvi
तद्—वत्—ता f. conformity, Vedāntas.; Bhāṣāp.
तद्—वन् m. pl. N. of a class of Ṛṣis (cf. यद्-वन्, तर्वन्, यर्व्˚), Pat., Introd. on Vārtt. 9.
तद्—वयस् mfn. of the same age, KātyŚr. xxv, 9, 1.
तद्—वश॑ mfn. longing for that, RV. ii, 14, 2 and 37, 1.
तद्—वसति mfn. dwelling there.
तद्—वा ind. = -वत्, q.v.
तद्—वाचक mfn. signifying that,
तद्—विकार m. अ- neg. no variety of that, Jaim. vi, 5, 47.
तद्—वि॑द् mfn. knowing that, familiar with that, AV. ix, 1, 9; ŚBr. xiv; Gobh.; Mn. &c. (also अ- neg., xii, 115; MBh. v; BhP. iv; न- neg., v, 4, 13)
तद्—वि॑द् m. = -विद्य, VarBṛS. ii, 20; Sarvad.
तद्—वि॑द् f. the knowledge of that, KauṣUp. i, 2.
तद्—विद्य mfn. a connoisseur, expert, Nyāyad. iv, 2, 47; Car. i, 25; iii, 8.
तद्—विध mf(आ)n. of that kind, conformable to that, Mn. ii, 112
his (or their) like, Suśr. i, 34; Ragh. ii, 22; Kum. v, 73; Mālav.
तद्—विध—त्व n. conformity with that, Mn. vii, 17, Sch.
तद्—विषय mf(आ)n. belonging to that category, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 66
having that for its object, BṛĀrUp., Sch.
तद्—विषयक mfn. attending to that business, W.
तद्—वीर्य-विद्वस् mfn. अ- neg., not knowing his manliness, BhP. vi, 17, 10.
तद्—वृत्ति mfn. living conformably to that, Gaut.
तद्—व्रत mfn. performing all duties towards (him or) her, Mn. iii, 45
performing the same religious observance, Gaut.
तदम् ind. ifc. for तद्, g. शरद्-आदि.

तदा॑ ind. (Pāṇ. v, 3, 15 and 19 ff.) at that time, then, in that case (often used redundantly, esp. after ततस् or पुरा or before अथ, MBh. &c.; correlative of य॑द् [AV. xi, 4, 4], यत्र [ChUp. vi, 8, 1], यदा [Mn.; MBh. &c.], यदि [Gīt.; Vet.; Hit.], यर्हि [BhP. i, 18, 6], यतस्, ‘since’, [MBh. xiii, 2231], चेद् [Śak. v (v.l.), Kathās. xi; Śrut.])
त˚दा-तदा then and then, Sāy. on RV. i, 25, 8
त˚दा-प्रभृति from that time forward, (correlative of यदाप्र्˚, R. iii, 17, 21; of यदा, Śak. vi, 4/5), R.; Ragh. ii, 38; Kathās. ii, 62
तर्हि तदा (correlative of यदि) then, Vet. iv, 24/25
यदा — तदा (both repeated or the verb being repeated), at any time when — then, Hit.
यदा-तदा at any time whatsoever, always, MBh. i, 6373; Naiṣ. viii, 39.
तदा—त्व n. (opposed to आ-यति) ‘state of then’, the present time, Mn. vii; MBh. ii f., v, vii; R. v, 76, 16 and 90, 1.
तदात्व-मात्र-श्रद्धेय see श्र्˚, p. 1096.
तदानीं in comp. for ˚नीम्.
तदानीं—तन mfn. then living, Uttarar. i, 2/3.
तदानीं—दुग्ध॑ mfn. (then i.e.) just milked, ŚBr. xi, 1, 4, 3.
तदा॑नीम् ind. (Pāṇ. v, 3, 19) at that time, then (cf. इद्˚), RV. x, 129, 1; AV.; MBh. &c., (correlative of यदा, VarBṛS. liv; of यत्र or यदि, Śrut.)
तदीय mfn. (Pāṇ. i, 1, 74, Kāś.) belonging or relating to or coming from him or her or that or them, his, hers, its, theirs, MBh. viii, 675; R. iv, 21, 35; Ragh. &c.
such, Daś.; BhP. viii, 20, 33 (न तदीयम् अण्व् अपि, ‘not even as little as that, not a bit’) &c.
तदीय—सङ्ग m. a meeting with her, Pañcat.
तद्रि॑यञ्च् m(nom. ˚यङ्)fn. extending thither, TS. v, 5, 1.
त˚द्र्यञ्च् mfn. id., Pāṇ. vi, 3, 92, Kāś.
तादुरी f. (for तातुरि fr. √ तॄ, Intens. ‘swimmer’, Nir. ix, 7, Sch.; but cf. दर्दुर) N. of a female frog, AV. iv, 15, 14.
तादर्थिक mfn. intended for that, Kauś. 60.
तादर्थ्य n. (g. चतुर्वर्णादि) the being intended for that, Jaim. vi, 1 f.; Anup. iii, 8; Pāṇ. ii, 3, 13, Vārtt. 1, Kāś.
the having that meaning, sameness of meaning, iv, 2, 60, Pat.
‘reference to that’
तादर्थ्येन instr. ind. with this intention, L.
तादवस्थ्य n. the remaining in the same (अवस्था) condition, Sāh. vii, 4/5.
तादात्म्य n. sameness or identity of nature or character with (instr., loc., or in comp.), BhP.; Sāh.
तादायनि m. patr. fr. त॑द्, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 93, Vārtt. 13, Pat.
तादी॑त्ना ind. (fr. तदि-त्न fr. तदि, correlative of य॑दि) at that time, RV. i, 32, 4.
तादृक्ष mfn. (for तद्-द्˚, Siddh.; Vop. xxvi, 83 f.) such a one, like that, Kāraṇḍ. xi, 70; Vcar. xvi, 53; Rājat. iv, 242.
तादृग् in comp. for ˚दृ॑श्.
तादृग्—गुण mf(आ)n. of such qualities, Mn. ix, 22.
तादृग्—भाव m. such a condition, MBh. v, 44, 22.
तादृग्—रूप mf(आ)n. of such a shape, such like, Pañcat.
तादृग्—रूप—वत् mf(ती)n. of such beauty, Nal. i, 13.
तादृग्—विध mfn. such like, Kathās.
तादृ॑श् mfn. (for तद्-द्˚, Pāṇ. iii, 2, 60; vi, 3, 91; nom. m. and f. ˚दृ॑ङ् [ŚBr.; cf. Pāṇ. vii, 1, 83] or ˚दृ॑क्) such like, such a one, RV. v, 44, 6 (nom. n. ˚दृ॑क्) &c.
तादृक् ind. in such a manner, Amar.
तादृ॑श mf(ई)n. (Pāṇ. iii, 2, 60; vi, 3, 91) = ˚दृ॑श्, ŚBr. xi, 7, 3; Mn. &c.
यादृश त्˚ [Pañcat.] or श-त्˚ [MBh. xiii, 5847], anybody whosoever.
ताद्रूप्य n. sameness of (रूप) form, identity, Pāṇ. vi, 1, 85, Vārtt. 26 (अ- neg.), Vām. ii, 2, 17
truth, Kaṇ., Sch.
ताद्विध्य n. the being such like (तद्-विध), Bādar. iii, 3, 52/53.
